env_hints.name: QG_REPO
env_hints.required_when: generate-out or runtime generation is executed without --repo
env_hints.detail: repository key used to resolve registry/repo rules, for example org/repo_name

env_hints.name: QG_CODEBASE_TOKEN or CODEBASE_TOKEN
env_hints.required_when: script rules need to fetch private Codebase modules, such as go.mod default-branch checks
env_hints.detail: personal access token; keep it in the local shell, CI secret store, host secret store, or ~/.qualitygate/shared.env

env_hints.name: QG_LOCAL_ENV
env_hints.required_when: MCP server should load developer-local secrets or binary overrides
env_hints.detail: optional path to a git-ignored local env file; external capsule/router mode normally uses QG_SHARED_ENV

env_hints.name: CODE_TOKEN
env_hints.required_when: GitLab/Code review comment collection is enabled

env_hints.name: QG_GREMLINS_BIN / QG_GOMUTANTS_BIN / QG_GOIMPORTS_BIN / QG_GOLINTX_BIN
env_hints.required_when: a managed runner binary needs an explicit external override
env_hints.detail: Go tools and golintx install under ~/.qualitygate/runner/bin by default; set the matching variable only for an externally managed binary

env_hints.name: QG_AST_BIN / QG_UT_MUTATION_GATE_BIN
env_hints.required_when: runner binaries are managed outside their default locations
env_hints.detail: binary overrides for the shared AST runner and mutation-gate integration

env_hints.name: QG_GO_COMPILE_TIMEOUT_SEC / QG_GO_COMPILE_TIMEOUTS_JSON / QG_GO_DEPENDENCY_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SEC / QG_GO_COMPILE_MAX_PARALLELISM
env_hints.required_when: changed Go packages need a compile resource or changed-module download budget override
env_hints.detail: compile uses registry repository profiles before the mode default; each Go build defaults to at most 8 package workers without changing MR job concurrency; RGO preparation and changed-module downloads have independent budgets and all explicit timeout overrides are bounded to 30-3600 seconds

env_hints.name: QG_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT / QG_UPLOAD_TOKEN
env_hints.required_when: Repair Ledger runs should be collected by the BOE platform
env_hints.detail: host install writes BOE MVP defaults into ~/.qualitygate/shared.env; override them for another ingestion target
